text:
Elena: Quick thread  launching 'inference-labs' (tutorial + reference app + mini-bench). Primary goals: drive repo contributions, webinar signups, and route enterprise interest to sales. Can we align owners?

Marcus: Love it. Recommendation: single-file tutorial for the workshop (`labs/start.sh`) so attendees can get to the demo in <10min. Also include a CPU fallback and a tiny dataset.

Priya: For registration, use HubSpot form `hs_inference_labs`. Add field `enterprise_interest` and a hidden `utm_campaign=inference_labs_q2`. Routing rule: enterprise -> AE queue; else -> devrel nurture.

Harper: Webinar plan: 8m intro + why reproducible perf matters, 22m live walkthrough (clone, run, tweak model/quant), 10m mini-benchmark showing batching & cache impact, 10m open Q&A. Keep it hands-on.

Marcus: Repo tasks: add `labs/quickstart.sh`, `bench/run.py` with reproducible flags, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` with `good-first-issue` examples. I'll open a PR tonight.

Elena: Messaging backbone for the blog: emphasize "reproducible performance" and a "perf badge" devs can run locally. Lead line draft: "Inference-labs: hands-on tutorials and reproducible benchmarks for inference at scale."

Priya: HubSpot mapping example for infra to implement webhook: 

`{ "form_id": "hs_inference_labs", "fields": {"email":"email","name":"firstname","company":"company","enterprise_interest":"enterprise_interest"}, "routing": {"enterprise_interest": "AE_QUEUE", "else": "DEVREL_NURTURE" } }`

Harper: Can marketing please include a short benchmark explainer (methodology) in the blog: p50/p95, payload size (100 tokens), model variant, instance types, batching off/on, quantization level. That helps reduce follow-up questions.

Marcus: I'll add a `bench/reproduce.sh` script that outputs a CSV + png for marketing assets. Suggest marketing include the png in the blog and as a gif for social.

Elena: Social copy suggestions (short):
- "New: inference-labs  hands-on tutorials + a perf badge developers can run locally. Live workshop coming. RSVP: <https://events.redwood.com/inference-labs>"
- "See how batching changes p95 in our mini-bench. Reproduce in 2 commands. -> <https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-labs>"

Priya: Routing automation note: only notify #sales-inbound when `enterprise_interest=true && company_size > 50` to avoid noise. I'll add that to the webhook docs.

Dev-rel-bot: Reminder: rehearsal slots open Mon 4pm & Wed 11am. Use `/reserve @Marcus @Elena` to book.

Marcus: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-labs/pull/9  includes quickstart, bench script, and a tiny `examples/minimal` dataset. Tagging @Elena @Harper.

Harper: I'll draft the webinar slides and short demo script. Want to show a live edit to batch size and see p95 change. Also include a brief slide about routing/fallbacks so customers understand Dedicated vs hosted behavior.

Elena: Owners checklist: 
- Quickstart + bench scripts -> Marcus
- Blog + benchmark writeup -> Elena
- Webinar + slides -> Harper
- HubSpot form + routing -> Priya
- Social assets + gif -> Marcus + marketing designer

Priya: I'll create HS workflow `hs_workflow_inference_labs_12` and set up an audience for ad retargeting of registrants who visit pricing.

Marcus: sample README snippet for workshop: 
```
# workshop quickstart
chmod +x labs/start.sh && ./labs/start.sh --mode local
# run bench
python bench/run.py --model local-quant --tokens 100 --batch 4
```

Harper: Draft blog link: https://docs.google.com/draft/inference-labs-launch. Will share comments by EOD.

Elena: timeline: merge PR + publishing assets Mon, webinar Wed, follow-up email Fri with recording + 'how to contribute' guide. Priya, can Growth run a 3-email drip for attendees?

Priya: Yes: 1) Thanks + recording, 2) How-to contribute + good-first-issues, 3) Enterprise offer. I'll coordinate with Growth.

Dev-rel-bot: Event created: "Inference-labs Workshop"  Wed May 12 10:00 PDT. Registration: <https://events.redwood.com/inference-labs>.

Marcus: pushed sample bench png to `marketing/assets/bench_snapshot.png`. Link in PR.

Harper: will ask two partners to co-amplify and offer a short segment. Pinged @open-ml-hub and @edge-deploy.

Elena: excellent. reconvene here after rehearsal for final signoff. Thanks team :rocket:
